tracks.menu_a: Warm Arabian lounge music for a Gulf majlis at night: soft oud melody, gentle qanun, light darbuka and riq rhythm, cozy and welcoming, coffee and dates mood, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.
tracks.menu_b: Elegant Middle Eastern background music for a game menu: oud and ney lead, warm strings, slow khaleeji rhythm on frame drums, inviting and friendly, loopable, instrumental, no vocals.
tracks.game_a: Mysterious suspense music for a social deduction game set in an Arabian council at night: low drones, sparse oud plucks, soft frame drum heartbeat, tension without being loud, leaves room for a narrator voice, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.
tracks.game_b: Dark and intriguing Middle Eastern underscore for a game of traitors and secrets: muted darbuka pulse, low strings, occasional ney phrases, quiet and tense, subtle, loopable, instrumental, no vocals.
